rows.title: PDF: a Skills title in Bars, Stacked or Tags style could be left alone at the foot of a page, because the first group's category (kept with its skills since R5-HUNT8) moved to the next page and the title never kept room for it (main column and the Sidebar's dark column)
rows.summary: Now: for Bars, Stacked and Tags the Skills title keeps the first group's category plus what that category keeps (the smaller of its keep and its skills' height: Bars' rows, Stacked's text or bullet lines, Tags at the whole keep), with a spare line. So the title moves to the next page with the category instead of ending the page alone. This holds in the main column (SkillsSection: over a Grids first row) and in the Sidebar's side column (SideSkills passes SideSectionTitle a presence, never less than its three lines). Fail-first: all 6 sweep cases (Classic and Sidebar x Bars/Stacked/Tags) fail without the fix and pass with it.

review.notes: 3791b92f reviewed against origin/claude/r4-green. Root cause fixed: the Skills title's minPresenceAhead now covers the gap under it (a spare line over its 6 pt margin), the first category's lines (main column: the larger of the face's natural line and the page line height, letter-spaced for Bars/Tags; side column: 1.2 x 8.5 pt plus its 2 pt margin) and min(category keep, measured skills). So the title can no longer stay behind when R5-HUNT8's category keep moves the category on. Arithmetic checked for short first groups (keep capped by what is under the category) and for Stacked's divider (4.5 pt) and Tags' 4 pt margin. The side column never drops below the title's own three lines, and a first group with no category keeps the old three-line default. Only PdfSectionsOne SkillsSection and PdfSidebarSkills SideSkills render these styles. Inline/Bullet are unchanged. Word export and the HTML preview do not use this code. react-pdf caps the presence at the end of what follows, so a last short section is unaffected. Fail-first run 36651264076: the 6 sweep cases fail without the fix (# fail 6) and pass with it, plus the area tests. Extra probe run 36652553377 (39 sweep cases on a throwaway branch claude/wf-r5-hunt10-pdf-probe, not merged): short first groups (Classic and Sidebar), a category that wraps, Grids (2 columns), compact 9 pt / 1.15 line height, and Modern, Minimal, Executive, Banner, Academic, Compact, Timeline for Bars, Stacked and Tags. 39/39 pass. The probe branch could not be deleted (the remote refused the delete), so it needs removing by hand. No a11y notes.

notes: Base is origin/claude/r4-green at 2a3f9dcc (the commits after 5c6c1e38 touch only import/export/tools/docs).
